'''Kasparas Jakučionis''' (born May 29, 2006) is a Lithuanian [[college basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois Fighting Illini]] of the [[Big Ten Conference]].

==Early life and youth career==
Jakučionis was born in [[Vilnius]] and started playing basketball in the youth ranks of [[BC Rytas-2|Perlas Vilnius]], a team affiliated with [[Rytas Vilnius]]. In 2021, Jakučionis joined the youth ranks of [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]]. In the 2022–23 season, Jakučionis alternated between Barcelona's junior team and the club's [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|reserve team]] in the [[Liga EBA]]. Jakučionis would be selected to the 2023–24 [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|U-18 Euroleague]] All-Tournament Team.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/baloncesto/euroliga/20240526/1002253885/azulgrana-jakuciones-quinteto-ideal-angt.html |title=El azulgrana Jakucionis, en el quinteto ideal del ANGT |website=Mundo Deportivo |access-date=19 January 2025 |language=es |date=26 May 2024 }}</ref> He would also make his professional debut for the [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] first team in April 2023, in a [[Liga ACB]] game against [[Fundación CB Granada|Coviran Granada]]. Upon his debut, he became the third youngest player to play for the Catalans in the [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.cat/ca/noticies/3208431/kasparas-jakucionis-el-tercer-debutant-mes-jove-del-barca-a-lacb |title=Kasparas Jakucionis, el tercer debutant més jove del Barça a l'ACB |website=FC Barcelona |access-date=19 January 2025 |language=ca |date=19 April 2023 }}</ref> 

On 28 May 2024, Jakučionis committed to play [[college basketball]] for [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] under [[Brad Underwood]].<ref name=espn>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/40233577/source-lithuania-kasparas-jakucionis-commits-illinois |title=Source: Illini land Lithuanian prospect Jakucionis |date=28 May 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Illinois Signs Jakucionis|url=https://fightingillini.com/news/2024/5/29/mens-basketball-illinois-signs-jakucionis.aspx|website=[[Illinois Fighting Illini]]|access-date=20 January 2025|date=29 May 2024}}</ref> [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] retains the player's rights upon a possible return to Europe.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/baloncesto/jakucionis-marcha-barca-busca-sueno-103024352 
 |title=Jakucionis se marcha del Barça en busca del 'sueño americano' |website=Sport |access-date=19 January 2025 |language=es |date=28 May 2024 }}</ref>

===Freshman season===
In his freshman season, Jakučionis earned [[2024–25 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season#Players of the week|Big Ten Freshman of the Week]] twice.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thechampaignroom.com/2025/1/6/24337871/illinois-kasparas-jakucionis-named-big-ten-freshman-of-the-week-again-fighting-illini-ncaa |title=Illinois' Kasparas Jakucionis named Big Ten Freshman of the Week (Again) |date=6 January 2025 }}</ref> He made his debut in November 2024, scoring 11 points in a win against [[Eastern Illinois Panthers men's basketball|Eastern Illinois]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/baloncesto/debut-kasparas-jakucionis-universidad-illinois-111423727 |title=Así fue el debut de Kasparas Jakucionis con la Universidad de Illinois |website=Sport |language=es |date=6 November 2024 |access-date= 19 January 2025 }}</ref> Jakucionis missed two games due to a wrist injury.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thetelegraph.com/sports/article/kasparas-jakucionis-injury-update-illinois-usc-20028732.php|title=Illinois basketball guard Kasparas Jakucionis misses second game with forearm injury}}</ref> Following the Big Ten regular season's conclusion, he was named to the Big Ten Third Team (both coaches and media) and the Big Ten All-Freshman Team.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bigten.org/mbb/article/bltd7e209f30bceb6f0/ |title=Big Ten Conference }}</ref> He later declared for the [[2025 NBA Draft]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/2025-nba-draft-scouting-report-kasparas-jakucionis-declares-after-all-big-ten-season-at-illinois/ |title=2025 NBA Draft scouting report: Kasparas Jakučionis declares after all-Big Ten season at Illinois |date=14 April 2025 }}</ref> and received a green room invite.<ref>{{cite web |title=NBA Invites 13 Prospects To Draft Green Room |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2025/06/nba-invites-13-prospects-to-draft-green-room.html}}</ref>
